properties.formula: state = Idle & !creditStored & selectedDrink = NONE
properties.description: R1: the initial configuration is Idle with no credit and no selected drink.

properties.formula: AG (state = Idle -> (!creditStored & selectedDrink = NONE))
properties.description: Idle always represents the absence of an active transaction.

properties.formula: AG (state = CreditAvailable -> (creditStored & selectedDrink = NONE))
properties.description: CreditAvailable always stores exactly one uncommitted credit.

properties.formula: AG (state = Dispensing -> (creditStored & (selectedDrink = COFFEE | selectedDrink = TEA)))
properties.description: Dispensing always has paid credit and exactly one selected drink.

properties.formula: AG ((state = Idle & event = insert_coin) -> AX (state = CreditAvailable & creditStored & selectedDrink = NONE))
properties.description: R2: a valid coin in Idle creates one credit and enters CreditAvailable.

properties.formula: AG ((state = CreditAvailable & event = press_coffee) -> (emit_DISPENSE_COFFEE & !emit_DISPENSE_TEA & AX (state = Dispensing & creditStored & selectedDrink = COFFEE)))
properties.description: R3: a paid coffee selection emits coffee and starts coffee dispensing.

properties.formula: AG ((state = CreditAvailable & event = press_tea) -> (emit_DISPENSE_TEA & !emit_DISPENSE_COFFEE & AX (state = Dispensing & creditStored & selectedDrink = TEA)))
properties.description: R4: a paid tea selection emits tea and starts tea dispensing.

properties.formula: AG ((state = Idle & (event = press_coffee | event = press_tea)) -> (!emit_DISPENSE_COFFEE & !emit_DISPENSE_TEA & AX (state = Idle & !creditStored & selectedDrink = NONE)))
properties.description: R5: drink buttons in Idle produce no drink and leave the machine in Idle.

properties.formula: AG ((state = Dispensing & event = dispense_complete) -> AX (state = Idle & !creditStored & selectedDrink = NONE))
properties.description: R6: dispense completion clears the transaction and returns to Idle.

properties.formula: AG ((state = CreditAvailable & event = cancel) -> (emit_RETURN_COIN & AX (state = Idle & !creditStored & selectedDrink = NONE)))
properties.description: R7: cancelling stored credit returns the coin and clears the transaction.

properties.formula: AG ((state = Idle & event = cancel) -> (!emit_RETURN_COIN & AX (state = Idle & !creditStored & selectedDrink = NONE)))
properties.description: R8: cancelling in Idle returns no coin and leaves the machine in Idle.

properties.formula: AG ((emit_DISPENSE_COFFEE | emit_DISPENSE_TEA) -> creditStored)
properties.description: R11: no drink output may occur without stored credit.

properties.formula: AG ((state = CreditAvailable & event = insert_coin) -> (emit_REJECT_COIN & AX (state = CreditAvailable & creditStored & selectedDrink = NONE)))
properties.description: R12: an additional coin is rejected while the original credit is retained.

properties.formula: AG (state = Dispensing -> (!emit_DISPENSE_COFFEE & !emit_DISPENSE_TEA))
properties.description: R9 and R10: a transaction cannot start a second drink dispense.

properties.formula: AG ((state = Dispensing & selectedDrink = COFFEE & (event = press_coffee | event = press_tea)) -> AX (state = Dispensing & creditStored & selectedDrink = COFFEE))
properties.description: R9 and R10: drink buttons cannot replace an in-progress coffee selection.

properties.formula: AG ((state = Dispensing & selectedDrink = TEA & (event = press_coffee | event = press_tea)) -> AX (state = Dispensing & creditStored & selectedDrink = TEA))
properties.description: R9 and R10: drink buttons cannot replace an in-progress tea selection.

properties.formula: AG ((state = Dispensing & selectedDrink = COFFEE & event = cancel) -> (!emit_RETURN_COIN & AX (state = Dispensing & creditStored & selectedDrink = COFFEE)))
properties.description: R13: cancel is ignored while coffee is being dispensed.

properties.formula: AG ((state = Dispensing & selectedDrink = TEA & event = cancel) -> (!emit_RETURN_COIN & AX (state = Dispensing & creditStored & selectedDrink = TEA)))
properties.description: R13: cancel is ignored while tea is being dispensed.

properties.formula: AG (emit_DISPENSE_COFFEE -> (state = CreditAvailable & event = press_coffee & creditStored))
properties.description: Coffee output occurs only for a paid coffee selection.

properties.formula: AG (emit_DISPENSE_TEA -> (state = CreditAvailable & event = press_tea & creditStored))
properties.description: Tea output occurs only for a paid tea selection.

properties.formula: AG (emit_RETURN_COIN -> (state = CreditAvailable & event = cancel & creditStored))
properties.description: Coin return occurs only when cancelling a stored credit.

properties.formula: AG (emit_REJECT_COIN -> (state = CreditAvailable & event = insert_coin & creditStored))
properties.description: Coin rejection occurs only for an additional coin when credit is already stored.
